findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_sites, get_overview, get_pages, get_sources, get_live, get_watch, get_watch_incidents, get_tracking_script, get_event_properties, get_event_revenue, list_site_team, get_transfer_status · Public sink: get_tracking_script.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_sites, get_overview, get_pages, get_sources, get_live, get_watch, get_watch_incidents, get_tracking_script, get_event_properties, get_event_revenue, list_site_team, get_transfer_status · Public sink: get_tracking_script

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
